headers.Hin: hin Mhnama capa Jesuh Khritawa mawng, thangkdaw ni” tia cuteiki. Jesuh cun khutbinak la ana takia khyanga ngdangsaka kyaki. A ana cun a mtheimthangnake, ngmüimkhya kse he a ja nängnak, la khyang hea katnak he a jah mhlätnak üng hmuha kyaki. Jesuh naw amät cun katnak üngka naw jah mhlät lü a xünnak jah pe khaia lawkia khyanga capa, ti lü a pyen.

verses.text:
\s1 Baptican Saja Johana Ngthu pyen 
\r (Mt 3:1-12; Lk 3:1-18; Jn 1:19-28)

Hin hin Pamhnama Capa\f + \fr 1:1 \fq Pamhnama Capa \ft tia avang üng am ami yuk si. \f* Jesuh Khritawa mawng Thangkdaw ni. 
\q1

\x -  \xo 1:2: \xt  Mal 3:1  \x*“Pamhnam naw, ‘na maa ka ngsä, 
\q2 lam pyang khaia ka tüi law khai.’ 
\q1

Acunüng, Johan khawkhyawng khawa ngdang law lü, baptican jah pe law lü, jah mtheimthang law lü,\f + \fr 1:4 \fq Johan khawkhyawng khawa ngdang law lü, baptican jah pe law lü, jah mtheimthang law lü ft ti cun avang üng Johan khawkhyawng khawa ngdang law lü, jah mtheimthang law lü \ft tia ng'yuki. \f* “Nami katnak nghlata u lü Baptican khan ua, Pamhnam naw nami katnak he ning jah mhlät khai ni,” a ti.
Acunüng, Judah khaw la Jerusalem mlüha khyang he ngthu ngai khaia Johana veia citki he. Ami katnak he jah phyeh u se Jordan tuinu üng Johan naw baptican a jah khansak.
\x -  \xo 1:6: \xt  2Sang 1:8  \x*Johan cun samu am ami pyan suisak suisa lü, savunksawmyüi a kcawi üng vawp lü, mkhaü he la mawkpyawnga khawitui jah ei awki.
Johan naw sang lü, “Ka hnua law khaia khyang ta keia kthaka kyäp bawk ve, kei cun kawp lü a khawdawkyüi ka kphyan pe khaia pi am ka ngkawihki ni.

Kei naw tui am baptican ka ning jah peki, cunsepi ani naw Ngmüimkhya Ngcim am Baptican ning jah pe khai,” a ti. 
\s1 Baptican la Jesuh hlawhlepnak 
\r (Mt 3:13—4:11; Lk 3:21,22; 4:1-13)
Acun käna ivei am ngsawk se, Jesuh Kalile khaw Nazaret üngka naw law se, Johan naw Jordan tuinu üng baptican a pet.
Tui üngka naw angxita a thawh law be üng, khankhaw nghmawng law lü, Ngmüimkhya cun mümca kba a khana kyum law se a hmuh.

\x - \xo 1:11: \xt Gen 22:2; Sal 2:7; Hesa 42:1; Mt 3:17; 12:18; Mk 9:7; Lk 3:22\x*Acunüng khankhaw üngka kthai naw, “Nang, ka ning jawng'engnak kcanga ka Capa, na khana ka je leng lengki,” tia, ngthang lawki.
Acun la Ngmüimkhya naw khawkhyawng khawa a tüih.

Acuia khawmhmüp kphyükip khawyam naw hlawhlep se awmki. Khisa he pi awmki he, acunüngpi khankhawngsä he naw law u lü ami msümcei law. 
\s1 Jesuh naw ngaksui kphyü a jah khü 
\r (Mt 4:12-22; Lk 4:14,15; 5:1-11)
Johan thawngim üng ami khyum käna, Jesuh Kalile khawa cit lü, Mhnama Thangkdaw pyen hü lü,
\x - \xo 1:15 \xt Mt 3:2\x*\wj “Akcün pha lawpäng ve, Mhnama khaw ng’et law ve! Nami katnak he jah nghlata u lü, thangkdaw jum ua!”\wj* a ti.
Kalile tuili kama Jesuh a ceh üng, Sihmon la a na Andru ngvai vawiki xawi jah hmu lü,
Jesuh naw, \wj “Na läk law nia, kei naw khyang man khaia ka ning jah mthei khai,”\wj* a ti.
Acunüng angxita ani ngvai jah yawk hüt ni lü, Jesuha hnu läki xawi.
Acun üngka naw, asäng va cit lü, Zebedea capa Jakuk la a na Johan, mlawnga khana ani ngvai jah na pyangei ni se a jah hmuh.

Jesuh naw a jah hmuh la jah khü se, ani pa Zebede la mlawnga khana ani jah ngvaha khyang he jah yawk hüt ni lü, Jesuha hnu läki xawi. 
\s1 Ngmüimkhyakse Mata Awmnaka Khyang Mat 
\r (Lk 4:31-37)
Jesuh la axüisaw he Kapenawm mlüha law u se, angawi Sabbath mhmüp üng Jesuh naw Sinakok k’uma lut lü, a jah mthei.
\x - \xo 1:22 \xt Mt 7:28,29\x*Thum jah mtheiki hea kba am kya lü, ana takia kba jah mthei se khyang he aktäa cäiki he.
Acunüng, ami Sinakoka k’uma khyang mat, ngmüimkhyaksea awmnak naw,
“Nazaret Jesuh aw, i mi nglak ve se ja? Na jah kpyeh khaia na lawki aw? Nang u ti ka ksingki. Nang cun Mhnama ngsä ngcim ni!” ti lü, ngpyangki.
Jesuh naw, “Ä khihkhe lü, a k’um üngka naw, angxita lut lawa,” ti lü, ngmüimkhya kse a ksät.
Khawyai naw acuna khyang cun ksün lü, angsanga ngpyang lü, lut lawki.
Khyang he ami van cäi law u lü, “Hin hin ia ngkhaw ni? Ahina mtheimthangnak hin akthai am niki aw? Ana takia kba khawyai he pi jah ksät se, a pyen ngaiki he hin,” tia mat la mat ngthähki he.

Acun la angxita, Kalile khaw avan üng Jesuha mawng ngthang hüki. 
\s1 Jesuh naw Khyang Khawjah a jah M’yai 
\r (Mt 8:14-17; Lk 4:38-41)
Jesuh la axüisaw he Sinakok üngka naw lut law u lü, Jakuk la Johan am, Sihmon la Andrua ima cit ktäiki he.
Sihmona pi, mhnatei se ngjänki, Jesuh a pha law la ami mtheh.
Jesuh naw a veia cit lü, a kut üng kaih lü, a mthawh la mhnat naw khya se, acun la a jah khinak.
Mü lam khawkyak käna, am phetki he avan la khawyai he naw a jah awmnak avan he cun Jesuha veia ami jah lawpüi.

Jesuh naw natnak ahmäi hmäia phäha am phetki he jah m’yai be lü khawyai he a jah ksät. Khawyai he naw ani cun ami ksinga phäha ani naw ä a jah ngthuheisak. 
\s1 Jesuh Kalilea Ngthu pyenki 
\r (Lk 4:42-44)
Ngawi lam khaw am a thaih phat üng, Jesuh tho law lü im ceh ta lü, anghinaka hmüna cit lü, va ktaiyüki.
Cunsepi Sihmon la a püi he cun Jesuh sui khai hea citki he.
Acunüng, ami hmuh law üng, “Khyang avan naw ning suihüki he ni,” ami ti.
Cunsepi, Jesuh naw, \wj “Ahina pipei ngnam hea pi, ngthu ka pyen khaia mi cit khai, acun vaia ni kei ka law,” \wj*a ti.

\x -  \xo 1:39  \xt  Mt 4:23; 9:35 \x*Acukba, Jesuh cun Kalile khaw avan üng cit hü lü, Sinakok hea ngthu pyen hü lü, khawyai he pi jah ksätki. 
\s1 Jesuh naw Khyang mat a M’yai 
\r (Mt 8:1-4; Lk 5:12-16)
Mnehkse mnehki khyang mat Jesuha veia law lü, a mkhuk ngdäng lü, “Na hlüei üng ta, na na ngcimcaihsak theiki ni,” ti lü, a nghuinak.
Jesuh naw m'yeneinak\f + \fr 1:41 \fq m'yeneinak avang üng mlungsonak tia ng'yuki. \f* am a kut sängki naw hnet lü, \wj “Ä, hlüei veng, ngcima,” \wj*a ti.
Acukba a pyen la angxita mnehkse cun khyük se, ani cun ngcimcai law beki.
Acunüng Jesuh naw ksükki naw a tüih be.

\x - \xo 1:44\xt Lev 14:1-32\x*Acukba a pyen käna, \wj “U am icapi ä na mtheh vai, cit lü, ktaiyü am na va ngtengei kyusak vai, acunüng Mosi naw a jah mtheha kba, na ngcimcainak ami msingnak vaia ngkengnak va pawha,” \wj*ti lü a tüih be.
Cunsepi, acuna khyang naw cit lü acuna mawng cun avan üng va sang hü se, Jesuh angdanga mlüh k’uma am lut thei lü anghinaka awmki. Acuia, khyang pung akce kce üngka he naw ami ceh si.

\s1 Jesuh naw Akxo a M’yai be 
\r (Mt 9:1-8; Lk 5:17-26)
Khaw mhmüp asäng ngsawk se Jesuh Kapenawma cit be lü ima awmki tia mawng cun ngthang hüki.
Ami luhnak vai khuiim am nghäng lü, mkawt peia pi thetkia, khyang khawjah ngcun lawki he. Acunüng Jesuh naw ngthu pyenki.
Acunüng, akxo cun khyang kphyü naw kawt u lü, Jesuha veia ami lawpüi.
Khuiima khyang be se, Jesuha veia am ami cehpüi thei. Acunakyase Jesuha ngdanga mkyung ami kpäk. Acunüng mkyung kpäk lawpäng u lü akxo cun a ihnak phak mah maha ami ju khyak.
Jesuh naw ihlawka ami jumeinak dämki ti hmu lü, akxo üng, \wj “Ka capa aw, na katnak he cun jah mhlät pänga kya ve,”\wj* a ti.
Acunüng thum jah mtheiki avang ngawki he naw ami mlungmthin k’uma ngai kyu u lü,
“I vaia hina khyang naw Mhnam ksekhanaka ngthu a pyen ni? Mhnama thea ta u naw katnak he jah mhlät thei khai ni?” ami ti.
Jesuh naw acunkba ami ngaihkyu cun angxita ksing lü, \wj “I vai acunkba nami ngaikyuki ni? \wj*
\wj “Ini akxoa veia pyen a jäi bawk kawm? Na katnak he jah mhlät pänga kya ve ti la; tho law lü na ihphak lo lü cita ti aw a jäi bawk?\wj*
\wj Khyanga Capa naw khawmdek khana katnak he jah mhlät theinaka ana taki ti nami ksingnak vaia ka mdang khai,” \wj*ti lü, akxo üng,
\wj “Ka ning mthehki, tho law, na ihphak lo lü, na ima cit bea,” \wj*a ti.

Avan naw ami teng k’um üng tho law lü, a ihphak lo lü, cit se aktäa cäi u lü, Mhnam mhlünmtai u lü, “Hina mäih am mi hmu khawi naw!” tia ng’yüngki he. 
\s1 Jesuh naw Levih a Khü 
\r (Mt 9:9-13; Lk 5:27-32)
Jesuh Kalile tuili kama cit beki. A veia khyang he law u se, Jesuh naw a jah mthei.
A ceh lama, Levih naki Alphaha capa ngcawnklawk junga ngaw se hmu lü, \wj “Na läk lawa,” \wj*ti se, Levih naw ngdüi law lü a läk.

Acun käna Jesuh cun Leviha ima\f + \fr 2:15 \fq Leviha ima \ft am acunüng ania ima \f* ei eiki. Ngcawnklawk he la akxawi he am Jesuh la axüisaw he ei ei khaia atänga ngaw hmaihki he. Isetiakyaüng, acuia awmki he cun khawjah law u lü, ami van naw Jesuh ami läka phäha kyaki.

Acukba Jesuh ngcawnklawk he la khyangka he am ei aw hmaih u se Mosia Thum jah mtheikia pharise he naw ami hmu üng, axüisaw he üng, “Ise hin naw ngcawnklawk he la khyangka hea veia ei aw hngaki ni? ti u se,

Acunüng Jesuh naw ngja lü, \wj “Khyang kphetyai he naw Seibawi am hlü u, am phetyaikie naw ni Seibawi ami hlü, kei hin khyang ngsungpyune jah khü khaia am law lü khyangka he ngjutnaka jah khü khaia ni ka law,”\wj* a ti. 
\s1 Ei Jeihnaka Mawng Ngthähnak 
\r (Mt 9:14-17; Lk 5:33-39)

Johana axüisaw he la pharise he naw ei jeihki he. Mhmüp mat üng khyang avang Jesuha veia law u lü, “Johana axüisaw he la pharise he naw ami ei jeihki he, ise nanga xüisaw he naw ami ei am jeihki he ni?” tia ami kthäh.
Acunüng Jesuh naw, \wj “Khin he cun cambumkia cangpyang ami veia a awma küt üng ami ei ka cit be khai he aw? Cangpyang ami junga a awma küt üng ami ei am jeih u. \wj*
\wj “Cunsepi cangpyang ami vei üngka naw, ami lakin lawnaka kcün pha law khai. Acunüng acuna mhmüp he üng ami ei jeih law khai he. \wj*
\wj “U naw suisak akthai kpyawn akphyüm am am kbun khawi naw, ami kbun üng akthai naw eitek se, acun käna ateknak ksehlen law khai. \wj*

\wj “U naw capyittui asü capyit um akphyüm üng am than khawi naw, acunkba ami than üng capyittui asü naw capyit um eipäk se, capyittui ngsawi lü capyit um pi se khai. Acunakyase capyittui asü cun capyit um akthai üng than khawiki he,”\wj* ti lü a pyen. 
\s1 Sabbatha Mawng Ngthähnak 
\r (Mt 12:1-8; Lk 6:1-5)
\x -  \xo 2:23:  \xt  Deut 23:25  \x*Jesuh axüisaw he am loma lama Sabbath mhmüp üng ami ceh üng, axüisaw he naw cangvui he ami jah kpyat.
Acun Pharise he naw hmu u lü Jesuh üng, “Tenga, Sabbath mhmüp üng na xüisaw he naw hinkba ami pawh hin mi thum üng am nglawiki ni!” tia ami pyen.
\x -  \xo 2:25,26:  \xt  1Sam 21:1-6  \x*Jesuh naw jah msang lü, \wj “Davit naw acuna mhmüp üng a khyang he am ami ei ngai law u lü ami pawh am nami kheh khawiki aw?\wj*

\x - \xo 2:26: \xt Lev 24:9\x*\wj Acuna Pamhnama im üng lut lü Pamhnam üng peta muk eiki. Ktaiyü ktung Abithaa kcün pät üng kyaki. Mi thum üng ktaiyü ktung he däng naw ami ei theia muk Davit naw ei lü a khyang he üng pi a jah pet cen,”\wj* ami ti.
Jesuh naw, \wj “Sabbath cun khyanga dawnak vaia pyana kyaki; khyang cun Sabbatha phäha pyana am kya.\wj*
\wj Acunakyase Khyanga Capa cun Sabbatha Bawia pi kyaki ni,” \wj*a ti.
Acunüng Jesuh Sinakoka khuia a luh be üng, acuia a kut vang lam xokia khyang mat awmki.
Ami mkateinak vaia, Sabbath üng akxo a mdaw law be täng täng la am a mdaw law be k’et u lü ami teng.
Acunüng Jesuh naw akutxo üng, “Ngdüi lü maa lawa,” a ti.

Acunüng khyang he üng, \wj “Mi thum naw Sabbath üng i ti vai ni a jah mtheh? Kpüi vai aw, mkhuimkha vai aw? Khyanga xünnak küikyan vai aw, mkhyüh vai aw?” \wj*ti lü jah kthäh se, 
 I pi am pyen be u.
Jesuh naw jah teng hü lü aktäa a mlung soki, cunsepi ami mlung nghlang lü ami kata phäha a pukseki. Acunüng akxo üng, \wj “Na kut sänga,” \wj*ti se, akutxo naw a kut a säng la daw law beki.

Acunüng pharise he Sinakok ceh ta u lü, Heroda khyang he am nghmu u lü Jesuh ami mkhyühnak vaia cengki he. 
\s1 Tuili kama khyang he
Jesuh la axüisaw he Kalile tuilia cit u se khyang khawjah naw ami läk. Acuna khyang he cun Kalile khaw, Judah khaw,
Jerusalem mlüh, Idume khaw, Jordan pipei üngka he, Turah la Sidon mlüh hea pipei üngka naw law hüki he. Acun he cun Jesuh naw a bilawh he khawjah ami ngjaka phäha a veia lawkia kyaki he.
\x - \xo 3:9,10 \xt Mk 4:1; Lk 5:1-3\x*Khyang aktäa adaa phäha a hama mlawngca ami nghängsak thüp thüp vaia axüisaw he a jah mtheh. Acun cun khyang he naw am ami net vaia phäha kyaki.
Khyang khawjah jah m’yai bekia kyase, ami hneh vaia ami ngcun law si.
Khawyai hea awmnaka khyang he naw ami hmuh üng a maa kawp u lü, ngpyang u lü, “Nang Mhnama Capa!” ami ti.

Jesuh naw khawyai he üng a unak ä ami pyen hü vaia a jah ksük. 
\s1 Jesuh naw Axüisaw he xaleinghngih a jah xü 
\r (Mt 10:1-4; Lk 6:12-16)
Acunüng Jesuh mcunga khana kai lü amäta ngaih he, a veia jah khü se lawki he.
Acunüng, ngsä hea a jah sui a xü xaleinghngih he jah xü lü, “Ka veia nami ve khaia ka ning jah xüki” ti lü a jah mtheh. “Ngthu nami sang hü khaia ka ning jah tüi khai,
acunüng khawyai he nami jah ksät khaia ana nami ta khai,” a ti.
A jah xüa xaleinghngih he cun: Sihmon, (Jesuh naw Pita a sui);
Zebedea capa xawi Jakuk la Johan, (Jesuh naw Boneraketa a jah sui, acun cun, “Mkyeka capa xawi”); tinaka kyaki.
Andru, Philip, Batolame, Mahte, Thomah, Alaphaha capa Jakuk, Thade, Zelot Sihmon

la Judah Iskarot, Jesuh cengkia khyanga kyaki he. 
\s1 Jesuh la Beelzebul 
\r (Mt 12:22-32; Lk 11:14-23; 12:10)
Acunüng, Jesuh ima citki. Khyang khawjah ngcun law be u se, Jesuh la axüisaw he ami ei pi am ei hlawt u.
Khyang he naw, “Hin hin yaw lawki va ni mäih ja,” ami ti a khuiim kyawnglawng naw sim u lü ngdumsak khai hea büki he.
\x -  \xo 3:22  \xt  Mt 9:34; 10:25 \x*Thum mtheiki he avang Jerusalem üngka naw lawki he naw, “Hina k’uma Beelzebul um ve! acuna khawyai hea mkhawnga ana am ni khawyai he a jah ksät ve,” ami ti.
Acunüng, Jesuh naw a veia jah khü lü, msuimcäpnak am, \wj “Ihawkba Khawyam naw Khawyam ksät thei khai? \wj*
\wj Ia pung pi amimät ngtung’atki he cun khawvei am khäng u naw.\wj*
\wj Ia khuiim kyawnglawng pi amimät ngtung’atiki he cun ngkyangtai khai he ni. \wj*
\wj Acunakyase Khawyam khaw ahnga hnga a ngkyangtai üng khawvei am khäng lü düt khai. \wj*
\wj “U naw khyang kyana im akcüka amät am a pinpawk ma küt üng a ima lut lü a khawhthem am yut thei naw. Acunakyase, im mah akyan cun khit ma khai. \wj*

\wj “Akcanga ka ning jah mthehki, nghnicim khyanga ca hea katnak avan la Mhnam pyetsenaka katnak\wj* \f +  \fr 3:28  \fq Mhnam pyetsenaka katnak am acunüng am dawkyakia katnak.  \f* \wj avan cun mhläta kya khai. \wj*
\x - \xo 3:29 \xt Lk 12:10\x* \wj Cunsepi, Ngmüimkhya Ngcim pyetseki cun itia pi mhläta am kya. Isetiakyaküng acun cun anglät katnaka kyaki,” \wj*a ti.

(Jesuh naw acun cun, “Hin naw khawyai a k’uma ta ve,” ami tia phäha a pyena kyaki.) 
\s1 Jesuh a Nu la a Bena he 
\r (Mt 12:46-50; Lk 8:19-21)
Acunüng, Jesuha nu la a bena he pha lawki he. Kpunga ngdüi u lü khyang mat tüi u lü ami va khüsak.
Khyang he a peia ngawki he naw, \wj “Tenga, na nu la na bena he kpunga ve u lü ning sui ve u,” \wj*ami ti.
Jesuh naw jah msang lü, \wj “U ni ka nu? Ue ni ka bena he?”\wj* a ti.
A peia ngawki he ngvei lü jah tengki naw, \wj “Teng u! hin he hin ka nu la ka bena he ni! \wj*
\wj U pi Mhnama a ngjakhlü tiki avan cun ka bena, ka cina la ka nua kyaki he ni,”\wj* a ti.

\x -  \xo 4:1  \xt  Lk 5:1-3  \x*Acunüng, Kalile tuili peia jah mthei be se, khyang khawjah a veia ngcun lawki he. Acunüng lawkia khyang he cun aktäa dämda u se, Jesuh mlawnga khana kai lü ngawki. Khyang avan tui kama tuinu ma na u lü, ngkhäm lawki he.
Jesuh naw msuimcäpnak he am hinkba khawjah a jah mthei,
\wj “Ngai ua, mhmüp mat üng khyang mat mci saw khaia citki.\wj*
\wj A saw k’um üng, mci avang lam khana kyakia kyase, kha he naw jawng law u lü, ami ei. \wj*
\wj Mci avang nglei am a danak bäk, lunga danaka kyaki. Nglei am thahkia kyase angxita pyo lawki.\wj*
\wj Nghngi lut law lü, khaw ngling law se, a pya am saükia kyase, ng’yawngki.\wj*
\wj Mci avang nghling hmua kyaki, nghling saü law lü, yai se am vuipai thei.\wj*
\wj Cunsepi, mci avang nglei kdaw üng kyaki, cawt law lü, saü law lü, avang thumkip, khyukip la aphyaa ngtheipai lawki,” \wj*a ti.

Akbäihnaka Jesuh naw, \wj “A ngjaknak vaia a nghnga taki naw ngja se,” \wj*a ti. 
\s1 Msuimcäpnaka Suilam 
\r (Mt 13:10-17; Lk 8:9,10)
Jesuh amät a ve üng, xaleinghngih he la akce läk hngaki he naw a veia law u lü msuimcäpnaka suilam a jah mtheh vaia ami kthäh.
Jesuh naw, \wj “Nangmia phäha ta, Pamhnama khawa mawng athukhlüng ksingnak vai ning jah peta kya ve, Cunsepi khyang kce hea phäha avan msuimcäpnak am pyena kyaki. \wj*

\x - \xo 4:12: \xt Hesa 6:9,10 (LXX)\x*\wj Acunakyase,\wj* 
\q1  \wj ‘Teng u lü pi, \wj* 
\q2  \wj am hmu u,\wj* 
\q1  \wj ngja u lü pi, \wj* 
\q2  \wj am ksing u. \wj* 
\q1  \wj Hmu ngja u lü Pamhnama veia ami nghlat be vai sü ta\wj* 
\q2  \wj ani naw jah mhlät khai sü,” \wj* a ti. 
\s1 Mciksaw Msuimcäpnak a jah Mthehnak khai 
\r (Mt 13:18-23; Lk 8:11-15)
